abstract: We encountered a case of mediastinal immature teratoma which revealed the feature of the so-called growing teratoma syndrome. A 20-year-old male with a cough was discovered to have an abnormal shadow in the mediastinum. The serum AFP was elevated to 3600 ng/ml. The specimen with percutaneous needle biopsy revealed mature teratoma. The tumor was suspected to be mature teratoma with a malignant component because of the high level of serum AFP and he underwent chemotherapy. The serum AFP declined markedly but the tumor further enlarged. The resected tumor was diagnosed as immature teratoma, although most of the tumor tissue was mature component.
abstract_ja: 縦隔未熟奇形腫の症例を経験し、いわゆるgrowing teratoma syndromeの特徴を示した。20歳の男性が咳嗽を主訴に受診し、縦隔に異常陰影が発見された。血清AFPは3600ng/mlに上昇していた。経皮的針生検の検体では成熟奇形腫が認められた。血清AFPの高値から、腫瘍は悪性成分を伴う成熟奇形腫と疑われ、化学療法が施行された。血清AFPは著明に低下したが、腫瘍はさらに増大した。切除された腫瘍は未熟奇形腫と診断されたが、腫瘍組織の大部分は成熟成分であった。
